simple.meaning: an Ezrachite or descendant of Zerach
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אֶזְרָחִי (H250) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: a.

simple.summary: אֶזְרָחִי (ʼEzrâchîy) means an Ezrachite or descendant of Zerach First listed occurrence: 1Kgs 5 11.

definitions.short: an Ezrachite or descendant of Zerach
definitions.full: H250. Ezrachi אֶזְרָחִי adjective, of a people i.e. of family of זֶרַח , only in הָא ׳אֵיתָן 1Kin 5:11 ( ᵐ5 L Ἰσραηλίτης ), Psa 89:1 ( ᵐ5 id. ), and 88:1 הָא ׳הֵימָן both sons of זֶרַח ( 1Chr 2:6 ).
